title: Readings and actions
description: A device described only in its own words: the readings it reports and the actions it offers, under whatever names it gives them. Drivers dropped in from other ecosystems land here. A capability with a shared vocabulary, such as switch, is better wherever one fits, because screens can then work with any device of that kind.

values.title: Reading
values.description: Something the device reports, as text.

values.title: Action
values.description: Something the device can be told to do. Send true to do it with its usual options, or text holding a JSON object of options.

values.title: Action options
values.description: The options the action takes, as a JSON list of fields, each with an id, a label, a type and a default.
